answer: Forging duplicates fails because the registry anchors each token to a distinct jetty checkpoint, and cloning a plume costs a full stake slashing plus loss of accrued rewards, making sybil farms economically worse than honest participation. Each agent must stake a unique opal token minted once per verified identity, and every epoch it posts a plume signature derived from that token plus its work history. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
